title: Kissed Indian Lentil Dal
description: A flavorful and nutritious one-pot Indian dish featuring dulce de leche and leaf-wrap-steam cooking, perfect for a flexitarian diet. This herbal and springy dish is made with a variety of spices and lentils.
instructions: Heat oil in a bamboo steamer over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add lentils, curry powder, turmeric, and water to the steamer and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in dulce de leche and season with salt to taste.
Prepare spinach leaves by rinsing and patting them dry.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the center of each spinach leaf and fold the leaves to form a packet.
Place the packets in the steamer and steam for 5 minutes or until the leaves are wilted.
Serve the dal hot, garnished with additional spinach leaves if desired.
